## Add a book to the gallery

**Title:**
**Author:**
**How Ghost Writer was used** (optional, a few lines):

### Checklist
- [ ] One folder `content/books/<book-slug>/` with `index.md` (and optionally `cover.jpg` / `.png` / `.webp`, max 2 MB; 2:3 ideal, square OK)
- [ ] The book was written (fully or in part) with the Ghost Writer plugin
- [ ] I am the author, or I have the author's permission to list it
- [ ] I have the rights to publish the cover image
- [ ] Links point to the book (store page, website, repository) — no affiliate or tracking links
